These are **synthetic**, offline test inputs, generated by the existing
`tests/allocation_targets_helpers.target_inputs` production service pipeline.
The compressed HistoryView and selection bytes retain original provenance and
hashes; do not rewrite fingerprints to accommodate platform differences.
`desktop_helpers.desktop_inputs` materializes a test-only SQLite database without
importing the Linux repository. Six synthetic price series have 505 observations.
